lines.text: Jesus passes through Galilee teaching His disciples that He will be killed and rise after three days.
In Capernaum, the disciples stay silent when Jesus asks what they discussed, because they had argued about who was greatest.
Jesus calls the Twelve, says the first must be wisest of all, and welcomes a child in His arms.

wrong_details.true: last of all and the servant of all

lines.text: John says they tried to stop a man driving out demons in Jesus' name, but Jesus says not to stop him.
Jesus warns that an eye causing sin should be plucked out to enter the city of David, and tells them to have salt.
